title: Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay Pricing Method: Service Fee, Card Funding Fee and Local Value
content:
The price of a Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay order is made up of the order value in US dollars, the service fee and, for a credit-card payment, the card funding fee. The value delivered abroad is the local value. Each is defined below; the flat fee, the percentages, the exchange margin, the accepted funding methods and the retry fee are the product's own figures in its tariff.

## Definitions

**Service fee.** The service fee of an order is the product's flat service fee added to the product's service fee percentage of the order value, the total rounded half up to the cent.

**Card funding fee.** A credit-card payment adds the product's credit-card funding fee percentage of the order value, charged as a card funding fee.

**Local value.** The local value delivered is the order value multiplied by the corridor's mid-market rate in the Paloma rate sheet for the order date, multiplied by one less the product's exchange-rate margin percentage divided by 100, rounded half up to 2 decimals — or to whole units for Vietnamese dong (VND).

**Funding method.** Payment must use one of the product's accepted funding methods.

**Retry fee.** A customer-requested retry carries the product's retry fee when that fee is above $0.00.

**Fixed price.** Prices never change after the order is placed.

On the order's ledger, the payment collected for the order value is shown; a service fee charge is shown when the service fee is not zero, and a card funding fee charge is shown when the order was paid by credit card and the card funding fee is not zero.

## Worked examples (all figures hypothetical, chosen for illustration)

**Service fee.** Take a product whose flat service fee is $1.75 and whose service fee percentage is 0.50%, and an order value of $123.45. The percentage part is 0.50% of $123.45, which is $0.61725. Added to $1.75 it gives $2.36725, which rounded half up to the cent is a service fee of $2.37.

**Card funding fee.** Take a product whose credit-card funding fee is 3.00%, and an order value of $20.00 paid by credit card. The card funding fee is 3.00% of $20.00, which is $0.60. Paid by debit card, the same order carries no card funding fee.

**Local value in pesos.** Take an order value of $100.00 in MX-MXN, a mid-market rate of 17.25 pesos per US dollar on the rate sheet for the order date, and a margin of 2.00%. The order value multiplied by the rate is 1725.00; one less 2.00 divided by 100 is 0.98; 1725.00 multiplied by 0.98 is a local value of 1690.50 MXN.

**Local value in dong.** Take an order value of $20.00 in VN-VND, a mid-market rate of 25,437 dong per US dollar and a margin of 3.00%. The order value multiplied by the rate is 508,740; multiplied by 0.97 it is 493,477.8, which rounded half up to whole units is a local value of 493,478 VND.

## Basis Q&A

**Does the rate sheet of a later day change an order already placed?** No. The local value uses the rate sheet for the order date, and prices never change after the order is placed.

**Is a retry charged?** Only when the product's retry fee is above $0.00.
